fields.label: App Profile ID
fields.help: The unique name of the app profile in the form '[_a-zA-Z0-9][-_.a-zA-Z0-9]*'.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Long form description of the use case for this app profile.

fields.label: Ignore Warnings
fields.help: If true, ignore safety checks when deleting/updating the app profile.

fields.label: Instance
fields.help: The name of the instance to create the app profile within.

fields.label: Multi Cluster Routing Cluster Ids
fields.help: The set of clusters to route to.

fields.label: Multi Cluster Routing Use Any
fields.help: If true, read/write requests are routed to the nearest cluster in the instance, and will fail over to the nearest cluster that is available in the event of transient errors or delays.

fields.label: Row Affinity
fields.help: Must be used with multi-cluster routing.

fields.label: Data Boost Isolation Read Only
Compute Billing Owner
fields.help: The Compute Billing Owner for this Data Boost App Profile.
Specifies that this app profile is intended for read-only usage via the Data Boost feature.

fields.label: Allow Transactional Writes
fields.help: If true, CheckAndMutateRow and ReadModifyWriteRow requests are allowed by this app profile.

fields.label: Cluster ID
fields.help: The cluster to which read/write requests should be routed.

fields.label: Standard Isolation
Priority
fields.help: The priority of requests sent using this app profile.
The standard options used for isolating this app profile's traffic from other use cases.
